samples.question: The image shows three closed black loops and two small colored dots: one green and one red. A loop is said to SEPARATE the two dots when exactly one of them lies inside the loop (the green dot is on one side and the red dot on the other). A loop does not separate them when both dots lie on the same side of it (both inside or both outside). Count how many of the closed black loops separate the green and red dots. Answer with a single number from 0, 1, or 2.
